postal_system.legal_rule: The UPU Brunei addressing sheet specifies six alphanumeric characters without an internal space and describes district, Mukim, village and delivery-point routing roles. The Brunei Postal Services second-edition booklet publishes Mukim, Kampong and postcode rows and address examples. These establish syntax, address order and dated routing assignments, not canonical polygons, civic addresses, building relations, complete current history or blanket redistribution rights. MTIC, AITI and PosBru confirm the transfer of postal operations to PosBru effective 1 January 2026. The SKN-hosted second-edition copy is a historical reference; its identity with the unavailable original and current PosBru allocation validity are not verified.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Every postcode is stored as an uppercase six-character text value. The first character is constrained to the UPU district letters B, K, P or T. A production assignment requires an exact source-attested Postal Services booklet row or a successor PosBru assignment row with Mukim, Kampong, edition, retrieval time and source digest pinned. Prefixes, equal names, office points, coordinates, administrative overlap or nearest features do not create a postal area or prove delivery to an address.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Brunei postcode polygon artifact is bundled. Official geometry requires an exact postal-authority boundary artifact and code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. A mathematical, Voronoi, interpolated or model-generated delivery surface remains derived and uncertainty-bearing; postcode prefixes, booklet rows, Survey maps or Geoportal lots, DEPS census geography, Land Department titles and OSM never become official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Addressee or organization, floor or unit, house number, building name, Simpang number, Jalan, Kampong, Mukim, town or district, P.O. box and six-character postcode remain typed. A postcode row, lot, title, census housing unit, coordinate or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit or exact civic address.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an authorized Survey Department house-numbering result or another rights-cleared civic-address identifier, separately permitted building geometry, and a source-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. Survey topographic buildings, Geoportal lots, Land Department records and DEPS housing statistics are candidates or validation evidence only; containment, text match, coordinate equality, proximity and nearest-building logic never establish the exact address-building relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Postal Services and UPU publications are reference evidence until exact reuse terms are recorded. Survey digital maps are paid products with product-specific coverage, scale and restrictions; Geoportal workflows require restriction-of-use acceptance and separate public and registered capabilities. House Numbering requires site plan, title or TOL, identity and payment. Census and land records retain statistical, title, ownership, transaction and personal-data constraints. Viewing, searching, purchasing, registering or paying never grants blanket redistribution rights. DEPS terms clause 2.1 positively permits reuse of covered content with attribution, change notice and no endorsement, subject to privacy and other terms; this is not a licence for Postal Services, SKN, PosBru or Survey artifacts. No exact postal-booklet redistribution rights are established.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addressees, recipients, senders, P.O. box holders, tracking or query records, applicants, identity-card numbers, site plans, titles, TOL records, owners, occupiers, tenants, transaction parties, mortgages, strata interests, households and census microdata are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.

stages.definition: A complete rights-cleared Brunei routing-assignment snapshot for a source-attested current national edition covers all four districts, with locality, government-organization, postal-branch and non-spatial P.O. box semantics kept separate; exact provider lineage, row/page identity, coverage reconciliation, validity, exceptions, source and terms SHA-256, reproducible transformation, approved immutable artifacts and real AGID lookup verification are required. Postal geometry and exact civic-address/building relations are separate optional layers, never inferred from assignments or prefixes.

m2_review.stage_boundary: Assignment attestation is M2; optional postal geometry, civic addresses and exact building relations remain separate later layers.
